rationale: DeleteTable removes a table and every item in it in a single call, and no confirmation stands between a mistyped table name, an over-broad automation run or a compromised credential and the loss of the data. Deletion protection makes the call fail until the setting is explicitly turned off, which turns an accidental deletion into a deliberate two-step action.
remediation: Enable deletion protection on the table, and keep it enabled on any table holding data that is not trivially reproducible
